messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — vendor (openweights-inc) pushed weights + tokenizer to s3://redwood-external-ingest/openweights/v0.3/ . We need to complete chain-of-custody checks before registry ingest: sha256 checksums, GPG-signed manifest, public key on vendor site, KMS-wrapped envelope key for encrypted artifacts. Assigning prioritization = high for this model (prod-facing generator).

Marta: @Sasha on it. can you paste the manifest here (manifest v2 with checksums)? will run sig + checksum verification. :white_check_mark:

Sasha: manifest snippet from vendor: ```
{
  "model_id": "ow-gpt-3-small",
  "version": "0.3",
  "weights_sha256": "d4f7e2b9c3a2f5b8d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1",
  "tokenizer_sha256": "a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d4f7e2b9c3a2f5b8d8e9f0",
  "signer": "openweights-inc-2026.pub",
  "artifact_size_bytes": 312409600,
  "quantization_recommendation": "ptq:int8",
  "notes": "trained on public corpora; license: cc-by-4.0"
}```

Ben: +1 on the checks. we require: (1) sha256 for both objects matches manifest, (2) GPG sig verifies against vendor pubkey hosted at https://openweights.example/.well-known/pubkeys, (3) S3 object ETag & size match manifest, (4) vendor provides a DOI or external provenance link if available. If any mismatch -> vendor must reupload and re-sign.

Leo: to verify locally:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-external-ingest/openweights/v0.3/tokenizer.zip - | sha256sum
# and for weights (streaming if > memory)
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-external-ingest/openweights/v0.3/weights.pt - | sha256sum
```

Marta: ran checks for weights -> weights_sha256 ok, size matched. tokenizer returned different sha256 (off by one). pinged vendor (ticket #IW-432). vendor re-uploaded tokenizer with new manifest and new signature 4m ago. I've re-verified new sha256 + signature. :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: starting pre-ingest validation job for manifest v2. checking encryption envelope, kdf, checksum. status: OK for weights, tokenizer OK after reupload.

Jide: I'll create the registry entry and assign a GUID. planned workflow: create model record in registry -> create version 0.3 record -> attach artifact pointers (s3 path, sha256, signer, provenance_url) -> set status = pre-onboard. Also add artifacts to content-addressable bucket under /ca/<sha256>/ for future dedupe.

infra-bot: Infra update — created KMS key alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1111111111:alias/redwood-model-ingest, enabled bucket encryption on redwood-external-ingest, lifecycle rule to move to infrequent access after 30d. created IAM role redwood-ingest-runner with least-priv.

Sasha: perfect. next steps: (1) Jide please set "pre-onboard" tag and schedule quant experiments on dedicated GPU pool (int8 PTQ + float16 baseline), (2) @eng-evals run quick eval harness against baseline testset (eval-id: eval/2026-03-17/ow-smoke) and flag >0.5% quality regression, (3) snapshot tokenizer vocab and add to registry metadata (tokenizer_version + merges).

Jide: noted — registry GUID = model-3012-kw, version_id = 0.3. scheduling quant jobs now (queue: dedicated/ptq-short). ETA ~2h. will attach job logs to registry entry when done.

Marta: added manifest and GPG sig to registry metadata and uploaded vendor pubkey URL to vendor record. Also created provenance.md with acquisition chain (who uploaded, who verified, timestamps).

Sasha: thanks team. once quant runs finish and evals look OK we'll promote to canary and do A/B against current hosted model. leaving this thread open for updates — please post final pass/fail and any diffs (perplexity/BLEU/ROUGE or rouge-like metric we use). :rocket:
